description: The agent must: (1) Discover from SKILL.md that the canonical input file path is `ref/agent-surveys/arxiv_ids.txt` and CREATE this file (it does not exist) with at least 2 valid arXiv IDs in the format YYMM.NNNNN — the agent must NOT use the decoy at `configs/arxiv_ids_backup.txt`. (2) Invoke the proprietary script `scripts/run.py` with the mandatory `--workspace .` flag (to write outputs into repo root), `--max-pages 20` (as specified in the prompt), and optionally `--overwrite`. A generic agent that tries to write its own downloader will miss the exact output paths and STYLE_REPORT.md auto-generation. (3) The script must successfully download at least 1 real arXiv PDF (> 10KB) into `ref/agent-surveys/pdfs/`, extract text (> 500 bytes) into `ref/agent-surveys/text/`, and produce the auto-generated `ref/agent-surveys/STYLE_REPORT.md` with the markdown table and Notes section. The proprietary traps are: the exact input file path, the `--workspace .` flag, the `--max-pages` flag, and the auto-generated `STYLE_REPORT.md` — none of which a general-purpose agent would know without reading SKILL.md.
